question:
‘A # B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’

‘A % B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’ If

‘P & Q # R % S @ T # U’, then how is P related to U?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c11302b7605fc4b1d94a3ac17568ea57d3f7b55dc2025c976df09cf4b05d35f.png]
